MP.note: Flagship. Mountain Pass mine + separation + Fort Worth magnet plant. DoD 2025 equity stake + ~$110/kg NdPr price floor + 10-yr magnet offtake. The funded, permitted, offtake-backed midstream reference.

USAR.note: Pure-play magnet + heavy-RE (Stillwater magnet plant + Round Top HREE). Funded but early — commissioning + cash runway is the key research item.

UUUU.note: White Mesa mill: only US mill doing both uranium and operating RE separation (monazite). Diluted by uranium/vanadium but real separation optionality.

ALB.note: Largest, most diversified lithium major; real cash flow but full commodity-price whipsaw. Benchmark anchor.

SQM.note: Lowest-cost brine producer; Chilean political/royalty overhang.

LAC.sub: Thacker Pass — largest US Li resource
LAC.note: US DOE loan + GM offtake; pre-major-revenue, ramp + capital-structure risk. High US-resource specificity.

SGML.note: Low-cost Brazil producer, early revenue, persistent takeover chatter.

FCX.note: Largest liquid US-listed copper pure-play; leveraged to electrification/AI-power demand.

SCCO.note: Lowest-cost, longest-reserve-life copper; Grupo Mexico control overhang.

VALE.note: Nickel/copper give critical-metal exposure; iron ore dominates. Cheap, high-yield, Brazil risk.

TECK.note: Transformed into a copper-growth story (QB2 ramp); clean-ish diversified base metals.

CCJ.note: Largest Western uranium producer + fuel services. Strategic-mineral overlap with real revenue; same reshore-the-supply-chain tailwind.

TMC.note: Frontier sourcing (Ni/Co/Cu/Mn nodules) — pure optionality, decade of regulatory/technical risk. Small speculative sleeve; will fail CS bar.
